```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)

source("./r/transition_helpers.R")
```

## Load

```{r}
#| label: load
deploy_df <- read_csv(
  "./datasets/2026-10-05_deployment_analysis_phase_1.csv",
  na = "NULL",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

test <- deploy_df %>%
  distinct(proqa_dispatch_code, proqa_dispatch_code_description)
```

## Incidents

One row per incident, with missing states as `"None"`.

```{r}
#| label: incidents
incident_df <- deploy_df %>%
  distinct(
    incident_number,
    proqa_case_type,
    proqa_dispatch_code,
    cad_initial_incident_type_code,
    cad_incident_type_code,
    rms_incident_type_code
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(-incident_number, \(x) replace_na(x, "None")),
    proqa_dispatch_key = make_dispatch_key(proqa_case_type, proqa_dispatch_code)
  )

unit_response_df <- deploy_df %>%
  distinct(
    incident_number,
    proqa_case_type,
    proqa_dispatch_code,
    cad_initial_incident_type_code,
    cad_incident_type_code,
    rms_incident_type_code,
    callsign,
    unit_type,
    dispatch_date_time,
    enroute_date_time,
    on_scene_date_time,
    clear_date_time,
    turnout_time_sec = as.numeric(difftime(enroute_date_time, dispatch_date_time, units = "secs")),
    travel_time_sec = as.numeric(difftime(on_scene_date_time, enroute_date_time, units = "secs")),
    on_scene_time_sec = as.numeric(difftime(clear_date_time, on_scene_date_time, units = "secs")),
    response_time_sec = as.numeric(difftime(on_scene_date_time, dispatch_date_time, units = "secs")),
    commit_time_sec = as.numeric(difftime(clear_date_time, dispatch_date_time, units = "secs")),
    unit_arrived_flag = if_else(!is.na(on_scene_date_time), TRUE, FALSE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(proqa_case_type, proqa_dispatch_code, cad_initial_incident_type_code, cad_incident_type_code, rms_incident_type_code, callsign, unit_type), \(x) replace_na(x, "None")),
    proqa_dispatch_key = make_dispatch_key(proqa_case_type, proqa_dispatch_code)
  )

apparatus_agg_df <- deploy_df %>%
  group_by(incident_number, unit_type) %>%
  summarise(
    responses = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = unit_type,
      values_from = responses,
      values_fill = 0
    )

```

## Lookup tables

```{r}
#| label: lookups
proqa_lookup <- deploy_df %>%
  drop_na(proqa_dispatch_code) %>%
  transmute(
    category_code = as.integer(proqa_dispatch_category),
    category_description = proqa_dispatch_category_description,
    level_code = proqa_dispatch_level,
    level_description = case_when(
      proqa_dispatch_level == "A" ~ "Alpha",
      proqa_dispatch_level == "B" ~ "Bravo",
      proqa_dispatch_level == "C" ~ "Charlie",
      proqa_dispatch_level == "D" ~ "Delta",
      proqa_dispatch_level == "E" ~ "Echo",
      proqa_dispatch_level == "O" ~ "Omega",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    subcategory_code = as.integer(proqa_dispatch_sub_category),
    subcategory_description = proqa_dispatch_code_description,
    code = make_dispatch_key(proqa_case_type, proqa_dispatch_code),
    code_description = paste(category_description, '-', level_description, '-', subcategory_description)
  ) %>%
    most_common()

# Only the final CAD type has a description column, so it also labels the
# initial type. A handful of initial codes never appear as a final type and
# will have no description.
cad_lookup <- deploy_df %>%
  drop_na(cad_incident_type_code) %>%
  transmute(
    code = cad_incident_type_code,
    code_description = cad_incident_type_description
  ) %>%
    most_common()

rms_lookup <- deploy_df %>%
  drop_na(rms_incident_type_code) %>%
  transmute(
    category_code = as.integer(str_sub(rms_incident_type_category, 1,1)),
    category_description = trimws(str_sub(rms_incident_type_category, 5, -1)),
    subcategory_code = as.integer(trimws(str_sub(rms_incident_type_subcategory, 1, 2))),
    subcategory_description = trimws(str_sub(rms_incident_type_subcategory, 5, -1)),
    code = rms_incident_type_code,
    code_description = trimws(rms_incident_type_description)
  ) %>%
    most_common()


# One table keyed by stage, because the same code can mean different things
# at different stages.
state_lookup <- bind_rows(
  proqa_dispatch = proqa_lookup,
  cad_initial = cad_lookup,
  cad_final = cad_lookup,
  rms_nfirs = rms_lookup,
  .id = "stage"
)
```

## Phases

```{r}
#| label: phases
# 1: Call Recievied -> ProQA case type
phase_1 <- incident_df %>%
  count_transition(NA, proqa_dispatch_key, 1, "call_recieved", "proqa_dispatch")

# : ProQA dispatch code -> RMS type
phase_2 <- incident_df %>%
  count_transition(proqa_dispatch_key, rms_incident_type_code, 2, "proqa_dispatch", "rms_nfirs") 
```

## Transition tables

```{r}
#| label: transitions

from_lu <- state_lookup %>%
  select(from_stage = stage, from = code, from_category_code = category_code, from_category_description = category_description, from_subcategory_code = subcategory_code, from_subcategory_description = subcategory_description, from_code_description = code_description)

to_lu <- state_lookup %>%
  select(to_stage = stage, to = code, to_category_code = category_code, to_category_description = category_description, to_subcategory_code = subcategory_code, to_subcategory_description = subcategory_description, to_code_description = code_description)

transition_df <- bind_rows(phase_1, phase_2) %>%
  #add_percent() %>%
  left_join(from_lu, by = c("from_stage", "from")) %>%
  left_join(to_lu,   by = c("to_stage", "to")) #%>%
  #distinct()

```

Hover over a tile for its count, or click it to pin the details above the plot.

```{r}
#| label: heatmap
heatmap_df <- transition_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(from), !is.na(to)) %>%
  mutate(
    tooltip = paste0(
      "From: ", from_code_description,
      "<br>To: ", to_code_description,
      "<br>Count: ", n
    )
  )

heatmap <- plot_ly(
  heatmap_df,
  x = ~from_code_description,
  y = ~to_code_description,
  z = ~n,
  text = ~tooltip,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  type = "heatmap",
  colorscale = "Magma",
  colorbar = list(title = "Count")
) %>%
  plotly::layout(
    title = "Incident type transitions",
    xaxis = list(title = "From", tickangle = -45),
    yaxis = list(title = "To"),
    margin = list(t = 120)
  ) %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el) {
      var box = document.createElement('div');
      box.style.cssText = 'padding:8px;margin-bottom:6px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;font-family:sans-serif;';
      box.textContent = 'Click a tile to see its transition count.';
      el.parentNode.insertBefore(box, el);
      el.on('plotly_click', function(d) {
        var p = d.points[0];
        box.innerHTML = '<b>' + p.x + '</b> &rarr; <b>' + p.y + '</b>: ' + p.z + ' transitions';
      });
    }
  ")

heatmap
```
